source: Daily report #96 (stable day, no Tier-2 items) + coverage audit vs test/unit/

suggestions.title: Add unit tests for LlmClientService (chatCompletion core paths)
suggestions.rationale: Most-depended-on service in AI pipeline (lesson-content, poetry-annotation, report services all consume it). Core paths — config defaults, OpenAI fallback mapping, maxTokensOverride, stripThinking, retry/fallback — have zero direct coverage.

suggestions.title: Add unit tests for ConversationService + AgentRegistryService
suggestions.rationale: Small, dependency-light agent-framework services. Conversation history management and agent registry are core to chat reliability.

suggestions.title: Add unit tests for SeederService (or BookSkillExtractorService)
suggestions.rationale: Seeder correctness determines first-run DB state; extractor parsing logic is pure and testable. Cover whichever is most testable.
